note: Outside the stated ICP, and the rep recognised it live and disqualified rather than discounted — the same commendable pattern recorded against Harry Edmonds on the Badrane Hriouch call. Matches neglected_health cleanly: 34, no crisis, no medical history, and health is precisely the area of life he has left untended — 'I've never done any sort of exercise in my whole life.' Misses income decisively: zero liquid cash, credit lines already committed to flights, 'I don't have the budget to pay somebody', and '6k is like five and a half k more than I could ever think of' — with a stated reference price of $25 for a fitness purchase. Misses good_to_great outright and in the most literal way in the corpus: the criterion asks for good going to great, and his own words are 'I've never been in a good shape, ever.' There is no 'good' to start from. Misses not_deconditioned on the aversion half of the exclusion rather than the weight half — he is not fifty pounds overweight, he is the mirror image at 148 lb and 6'1", but the exclusion's operative pairing is untrained plus hates working out, and he stated the second part unambiguously: 'I'd rather watch a TV series than work out' and 'going to the gym, for me, it doesn't make sense... I don't like it.' The 'successful' criterion is deliberately recorded in neither list: he self-identifies as a business owner ('you're a businessman, I'm a business guy too', 'I do this for a living as well') and his Zoom label carries a company name, but the rep never asked what he does, so the occupation test is unverified rather than passed or failed — and the rep then built the entire money conversation on the businessman assumption, which is the finding. Judged on the criteria, not the outcome, and the two point the same way here: an ad-sourced lead who did not know what the call was, sitting three of five criteria outside the definition, should not have reached a closer at all.
